exposure: 2 doses of amoxicillin-clavulanic acid as prophylactic antibiotics following cesarean section
7 days course of amoxicillin-clavulanic acid and metronidazole as prophylactic antibiotics following cesarean section
finding: No statistically significant difference was found in infectious morbidity, duration of hospital stay, or neonatal outcomes between the two-dose and seven-day prophylactic antibiotic regimens following CS, with the two-dose regimen demonstrating reduced cost and maternal side effects.
